description: Indian plant-based meat brand (GoodDot, FSSAI certified) selling meat-alternative products direct to consumers. Its affiliate program is explicitly built for creators: recipe creators, fitness influencers, vegan bloggers, mom/family creators, lifestyle YouTubers, cookbook authors, nutritionists and food reviewers, with free Reels templates, recipe scripts and product photos provided.

evidence.summary: Own affiliate page: 10% commission on every order placed using your code, 'with no cap on earnings'; FAQ 'Is there a cap on what I can earn?' — 'None. Top affiliates clear Rs 3,00,000+ in a single month. Earnings scale directly with the value you create.' 30-day cookie, real-time dashboard via GoAffPro, monthly UPI payouts above a Rs 500 minimum, auto-approved signup, no minimum follower count.

Page states 'Join 200+ creators earning with GoodDot' and lists suitable creator types (recipe creators, fitness influencers, vegan/vegetarian bloggers, mom & family creators, lifestyle YouTubers, cookbook authors, nutritionists, food reviewers); active affiliates receive a free monthly product hamper. The 200+ figure is a few-hundred count, so saturation is recorded as unknown under the strict absolute-terms rule.
Brand describes itself on the program page as India's #1 plant-based meat brand, FSSAI certified, featured in Forbes, Fortune and Economic Times.

name: GoodDot

reasons.compensation: Published 10% on every order AND verified uncapped — own FAQ answers the cap question with 'None.'
reasons.contact_access: No published email on the program page; support runs through the affiliate dashboard and a WhatsApp group after joining.
reasons.credibility: FSSAI certified brand; own page cites Forbes, Fortune and Economic Times features.
reasons.niche_fit: Plant-based meat is a strong food-creator niche; program explicitly targets recipe, fitness and vegan creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Auto-approved in 30 seconds, no paperwork, no waiting list, no minimum follower count.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Program is creator-first: free Reels templates, recipe scripts, product photos, monthly product hampers for active affiliates.

description: UK online cake-decorating school founded by Paul Bradford, with 900+ video courses (1,000+ hours of tuition) sold as individual tutorials and memberships. Its long-running affiliate program pays commission on tutorial and membership sales referred by blogs, Facebook pages and other food/baking sites.

evidence.summary: Own affiliate page: 30% commission on individual tutorial sales and 30% of the initial membership fee (50% for guest tutors selling their own tutorials); 'How much can I expect to make? ... There is no cap on the amount you can earn, meaning, whether your link achieves one sale or 10,000 sales, you will receive commission for each of those sales.' 30-day cookie, monthly payouts at a GBP 50 threshold, applications individually reviewed within 72 hours.

Program welcomes everyone from 'a small Facebook page or the biggest site on the internet'; partners get banners, ad copy and collaborative blog/YouTube promotion. Page frames the audience as websites/blogs with significant traffic, so it is content-site oriented rather than a pure short-form creator program.

name: CakeFlix

reasons.compensation: 30% on tutorials and memberships AND verified uncapped, stated explicitly on the brand's own page.
reasons.contact_access: Contact is via the site's affiliate contact route (email address is masked in page text); applications reviewed within 72 hours.
reasons.credibility: Established school: 900+ courses, founder has made cakes for royalty and celebrities per the program page.
reasons.niche_fit: Cake decorating is a focused food niche with a large tutorial-buying audience; narrower than general food.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free to join but individually reviewed; page speaks to sites with significant traffic, so approval is not automatic.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Open to bloggers and Facebook pages of any size with banners, ad examples and partner blog/YouTube collaborations.

description: US organic foods brand (the online store of Wilderness Family Naturals, northern Minnesota) selling coconut oil, cacao, nuts, superfoods and body care it prepares and packages in its own US facilities. Its affiliate program, running on Affiliatly, is aimed at bloggers and social media promoters of natural foods.

evidence.summary: Own affiliate page: 'From the start, you'll earn 10% of completed orders. It's possible to earn up to 20%!' 30-day cookie, payouts once $50 minimum commission is earned, free to join; the page's 'Login or Join Now!' link routes to Affiliatly. No cap statement is published, so the cap is recorded as unknown. Contact shown on the page: help@wildlyorganic.com, +1 (218) 226-3985.

Brand states it has operated for 16 years, prepares and packages nearly everything it sells in its own facilities in the USA, and lets affiliates attach their affiliate ID to the blog's evergreen content as well as their own channels.

name: Wildly Organic

reasons.compensation: 10% starting rate rising to a possible 20%; no published cap statement, so cap honestly unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Published support email and phone number directly on the affiliate page.
reasons.credibility: 16-year operating history and own US production facilities, per the brand's own page.
reasons.niche_fit: Organic pantry staples and superfoods fit food, recipe and natural-living creators well.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free to join through the Affiliatly portal linked from the program page.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Program is pitched at bloggers and social promoters with promotional tools provided; no dedicated creator perks beyond that.

description: US home-wellness equipment brand selling infrared and traditional home saunas, cold plunges, infrared blankets and red light therapy products. Its affiliate program, run on Impact, explicitly recruits bloggers, influencers and content creators in the fitness, wellness, biohacking and nutrition space.

evidence.summary: Own affiliate page: 'Are you a blogger, influencer, or content creator with a presence in the fitness/wellness/biohacking/nutrition space? ... you are welcome to join our affiliate program.' Signup links route to Impact (app.impact.com); partners get tracking links and a unique promo code (requested via info@sunhomesaunas.com), are paid monthly by PayPal or Venmo, and product-for-content requests go to the same email. The page's 'There are no limits!' line refers to where links may be displayed, NOT to earnings, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

Network-listing aggregator reports Sun Home Saunas at a 5%-5.3% commission with Impact as the direct network (base 5% listed on Impact; also on Skimlinks/Connexity as sub-affiliate routes). The 5% Impact base rate is recorded; confirm current terms inside Impact before promoting.

name: Sun Home Saunas

reasons.compensation: Low 5% percentage but on very high-ticket products (saunas), so per-sale payouts can still be large; no cap statement published.
reasons.contact_access: Published partner email (info@sunhomesaunas.com) for promo codes, product requests and questions.
reasons.credibility: Established US wellness-equipment seller with a full affiliate FAQ on its own site.
reasons.niche_fit: Saunas, cold plunges and red light are core biohacking/wellness topics; filed under home as the products are home equipment.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application via Impact with brand approval; monthly payouts.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Own page directly invites bloggers, influencers and content creators and offers product for content on request.

description: US fitness-tech brand (Lake Nona, Florida) making Suji, a smart targeted-compression / blood-flow-restriction training and recovery device used by professional sports teams and physical therapists. Its affiliate program on GoAffPro pays creators 10% on referred sales.

evidence.summary: Own affiliate page: 'Earn 10% commission by sharing a product trusted by elite athletes, physical therapists, and thousands of active individuals.' Apply buttons route to the brand's GoAffPro portal (trysuji.goaffpro.com). The program targets fitness & wellness creators, physical therapists/trainers and active individuals, and provides creative assets, videos, photos and captions. No cap statement published, so cap is unknown.
Brand states its customers include 40% of American sports teams and hundreds of healthcare professionals, and its site reports a Men's Health Tech Awards win for the device.

name: Suji

reasons.compensation: Published 10% on every referred sale; no cap statement, so cap honestly unknown.
reasons.contact_access: No published email on the affiliate page; contact runs through the GoAffPro application.
reasons.credibility: Pro-team adoption claims and a Men's Health Tech Award reported on the brand's own site.
reasons.niche_fit: Smart BFR/recovery device sits squarely in fitness and recovery content.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application via GoAffPro with dashboard tracking.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Page explicitly recruits fitness & wellness creators and supplies creative assets and guidance.

description: US wellness brand selling premium grass-fed bovine colostrum supplements. Its affiliate program, run on Social Snowball with tiered commissions and automated monthly payouts, turns customers and micro-influencers into affiliates and drove $473K+ in affiliate revenue in its first seven months on the platform.

evidence.summary: Social Snowball case study of the brand's own program: structured affiliate tiers with different commission levels by performance, automated monthly payouts via Tremendous, 'anyone can get a link', heavy micro-influencer and customer participation, 1,725 affiliates onboarded and $473K+ in affiliate-driven revenue in seven months (top affiliate: 1,000+ referral orders). Commission percentages are set per tier and are not published, so the rate is recorded as null; the 1,725-affiliate count is neither ~100-scale nor 10,000-scale, so saturation is unknown.

Case study quotes the brand's Head of Partnerships (Taylor Fulton-Girgis) and describes product seeding to interested creators followed by personalized links/codes, monthly affiliate newsletters with marketing ideas, and Instagram content tracking — an actively managed creator program. The brand previously ran the program on Impact before moving to Social Snowball.

name: Cowboy Colostrum

reasons.compensation: Tiered commissions exist but no percentage is published anywhere fetched, so the rate is honestly null.
reasons.contact_access: A named Head of Partnerships runs the program, but no public contact email was found on a fetched page.
reasons.credibility: Documented $473K+ affiliate revenue and 1,700+ affiliates in a named platform case study.
reasons.niche_fit: Colostrum is a high-demand wellness supplement category with strong creator interest.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open, low-friction onboarding — 'anyone can get a link' per the platform case study.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Program is built on micro-influencers and customers, with product seeding, content tracking and affiliate newsletters.

description: American non-alcoholic spirit alternatives brand (tequila, gin, whiskey and aperitif alternatives made with natural botanicals, no added sugar). Its affiliate program on Awin pays a base 5% revenue share with a 30-day cookie and targets cocktail, recipe and healthy-lifestyle creators.

evidence.summary: Program page from the brand's affiliate management agency (Today's Business): the Ritual Zero Proof affiliate program runs on Awin with a base 5% RevShare payout 'with opportunity for increase', a 30-day cookie window, product-for-review and giveaway opportunities, and a dedicated account manager. US traffic only; the program actively seeks bloggers and influencers (cocktail enthusiasts, recipe influencers, health-conscious and parent creators). Affiliate team contact published on the page: affiliate@todaysbusines4.wpenginepowered.com. No cap statement, so cap is unknown.

name: Ritual Zero Proof

reasons.compensation: Base 5% revenue share with stated opportunity for increase; modest rate, no cap statement published.
reasons.contact_access: Published affiliate-team email and a dedicated account manager for the program.
reasons.credibility: Established category brand with a professionally managed network program.
reasons.niche_fit: Non-alcoholic spirits are a fast-growing drinks niche for cocktail and sober-curious creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through Awin for US-traffic publishers.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Program page explicitly recruits bloggers and influencers and offers product for review and audience giveaways.

description: Canadian digital-wellness company (Hapbee Technologies, publicly traded on TSXV: HAPB) whose wearable Neckband and Sleep Pad use low-energy magnetic signals to deliver feelings such as focus, calm and sleepiness without ingestibles. In July 2025 it launched an integrated Affiliate and Ambassador Program open to creators of any size.

evidence.summary: Own Brand Ambassadors page invites creators to 'Become a Hapbee Affiliate or Ambassador', share authentic content about the Neckband and Sleep Pad, and earn affiliate rewards; it targets wellness, women's health, lifestyle, family and tech voices 'from anywhere in the world'. No commission rate or cap statement is published on the page, so both are recorded honestly (rate null, cap unknown).

Company press release (July 29, 2025) announcing the official launch of its technology-integrated Affiliate and Ambassador Program: open to all wellness advocates and creators 'regardless of the size of their social media following', with real-time dashboards and payout visibility; signup via hapbee.com/pages/collabs. Endorsers named include Gary Brecka, Ben Greenfield and Dave Asprey.

name: Hapbee

reasons.compensation: Program pays affiliate rewards/commissions, but no rate is published on any fetched page, so the rate is honestly null.
reasons.contact_access: Application via the brand's collabs page; no published partnerships email found.
reasons.credibility: Publicly traded company (TSXV: HAPB) with named high-profile users and a formal program launch.
reasons.niche_fit: Digital wellness wearable fits biohacking, sleep and focus content niches.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to creators of any follower size worldwide, per the launch release.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Dedicated affiliate/ambassador program built around creators sharing authentic everyday content.

description: Brain-fitness technology brand whose headset and app deliver guided light-and-sound sessions for sleep, stress and focus. Alongside its clinic-focused Professional Partner Program, BrainTap runs an Affiliate Program (on Post Affiliate Pro since November 2026) for coaches and creators who share a link and earn commission on referred sales.

evidence.summary: Own partner page offers three routes; the 'Affiliate' route is described as: 'Share your link. Your audience buys directly from BrainTap and you earn commission', best for 'Coaches, creators, anyone without a location', no location needed. (The 30% commission figure on the same page belongs to the Professional Partner 'sell on commission' route for practices, not the affiliate link program, so it is not recorded as the affiliate rate.)

Brand's own program update: on November 1, 2026 the affiliate program moved from LeadDyno to Post Affiliate Pro (portal: affiliate.braintap.com); new affiliates apply, agree to terms, and are reviewed within 24-72 hours, with approval including confirmation of an active BrainTap subscription; commissions are paid via PayPal. The Post Affiliate Pro directory lists the program at 20-30% commission with a 60-day cookie and $100 minimum payout, but because BrainTap's own pages do not publish the affiliate rate, the rate is recorded as null with the directory range documented here.

name: BrainTap

reasons.compensation: Directory lists 20-30%, but the brand does not publish the affiliate rate on its own pages, so the recorded rate is null.
reasons.contact_access: No published affiliate email on fetched pages; contact runs through the partner application/discovery-call route.
reasons.credibility: Established brand with a documented, recently migrated affiliate platform and published program terms.
reasons.niche_fit: Brain fitness, sleep and stress tech is a defined wellness niche with engaged audiences.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Application plus 24-72h review, and approval involves confirming an active BrainTap subscription, which narrows who can join.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A dedicated affiliate route explicitly names coaches and creators as its audience.

description: Wearable basal body temperature fertility monitor (Tempdrop 1/2 kits) for cycle tracking and family planning. Its affiliate program, run through Affiliatly, gives members a unique code and link offering customers 10% off Tempdrop kits, with a cash reward on every sale made using the code.

evidence.summary: Brand's Affiliatly affiliate dashboard page: members receive a unique code and link offering a 10% discount on Tempdrop kits and earn a cash reward for every sale made using the code; Tempdrop seeks active affiliates who share its mission and asks affiliates to achieve at least 10 sales per year to remain in the program; applications are reviewed by the team.

Program terms (Tempdrop Ltd): commission is paid per referred customer purchase of a Tempdrop fertility monitor kit 'at the rate determined by Tempdrop from time to time and notified to the Affiliate in advance through the Dashboard' — the rate is not published publicly, so it is recorded as null. No cap or creator-count statement is published, so cap and saturation are unknown.

name: Tempdrop

reasons.compensation: Cash rewards are paid per sale, but the rate is only disclosed inside the dashboard, so the recorded rate is null.
reasons.contact_access: No published contact email on the program pages; contact runs through the affiliate application.
reasons.credibility: Established fertility-monitor brand with formal published program terms.
reasons.niche_fit: Fertility tracking is a focused women's-health niche with highly engaged creator communities.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application with team review; affiliates must reach 10 sales per year to stay in the program.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Code-and-link affiliate program aimed at people who share the brand's mission; no formal creator perks published.
